modalLead: Config looks like the theme everywhere, and a phone no longer gets key hints.

items.text: Selects, checkboxes and radios wear the theme. They no longer show the system's own arrows and white boxes.
The preview beside the Appearance tabs is lighter. It is no longer a black block on dark themes.
Watch feeds is a table like Structure. A column head and flat rows, one per feed.
No key hints on a phone. The key legends and the two key tips in the bell stay away on a touch device without a mouse.
